primary_endpoint: Treatment-emergent adverse events, change in ALT and AST, and change in liver fat by MRI; Parts A and B at Week 12, Part C at Week 48.
efficacy_outcome: ALT decreased by 16.7–28.7 IU/L across tropifexor doses versus 8.1 IU/L for Parts A+B placebo and 11.7 IU/L for Part C placebo; AST decreased by 2.1–16.7 U/L versus 7.1 and 13.1 U/L, respectively. Liver fat decreased by 7.48%–39.54% across doses versus 6.19% and 3.58% for placebo; reported MRI comparisons included p=0.029 and p<0.001.
safety_signal: TEAEs occurred in 5–61 participants across tropifexor dose groups, versus 31 in Parts A+B placebo and 46 in Part C placebo. Serious AEs: 0/13, 0/17, 0/37, 4/85, 5/50, and 3/51 across tropifexor groups versus 6/97 with placebo; no deaths.
